events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Kent Nishimura on Monday, August 31, 2026, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The official venue page identifies Nishimura as the sole announced performer on guitar and marks the engagement as his first appearance at COTTON CLUB. The venue and Nishimura's official biography describe his work as solo fingerstyle guitar built around technically demanding arrangements; his official biography notes that he began focusing on solo guitar at age six, released his debut album at twelve, and won the 2017 Fingerpicking Day national competition as its youngest-ever grand champion.

en.why_it_matters: This belongs on RADAR because the instrument is the event. Nishimura's fingerstyle language compresses bass line, harmony, percussion and melody into one acoustic guitar, and a COTTON CLUB debut with no announced backing band leaves that arrangement craft completely exposed. The appeal is not that a young guitarist has accumulated a large online audience; it is the chance to hear a technically extreme solo vocabulary at club distance, where touch, voicing and rhythmic independence are easy to judge in real time.
en.trip_verdict: Keep it on the board if August 31 is open in Tokyo, especially if the trip is already following guitar and instrumental identity. I would take a set if the night is free, but I would not move a rarer master, premiere, reunion or one-off to make room for it.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta entra al RADAR porque el instrumento es el acontecimiento. El fingerstyle de Nishimura comprime línea de bajo, armonía, percusión y melodía dentro de una sola guitarra acústica, y su debut en COTTON CLUB sin banda anunciada deja completamente expuesto ese trabajo de arreglo. Lo interesante no es que un guitarrista joven haya acumulado muchísimas reproducciones en línea, sino escuchar de cerca un vocabulario solista técnicamente extremo, donde el toque, las voces internas y la independencia rítmica se pueden juzgar en tiempo real.
es.trip_verdict: La tendría en el tablero si el 31 de agosto está libre en Tokio, especialmente si el viaje ya viene siguiendo guitarra e identidad instrumental. Iría a uno de los sets si la noche está despejada, pero no desplazaría por esto a un maestro más raro, un estreno, una reunión o una fecha verdaderamente irrepetible.
